data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE confirmed (high confidence): ticket-create.sh lines 266-267 emit dual-output stdout but 12 test files capture ticket create output without | tail -1. Three _create_ticket() helpers return echo "$out" without filtering; 8 files use bare subshell captures; test-ticket-autoinit.sh additionally uses a full-stdout regex that cannot match two-line output. Fix: add | tail -1 to all captures and fix autoinit regex.
